privacyPolicy.title: SawDash — Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.content:
Privacy Policy for SawDash

Last updated: September 2026

1. Introduction
This Privacy Policy explains how SawDash ('the app', 'we', 'us') handles information. SawDash is developed and operated by an independent developer, contactable at viictoriaahiils@gmail.com. This policy applies to the SawDash Android and iOS app and covers what limited information the app stores, and what information our advertising provider (such as Google AdMob) may process when ads are shown.

2. Information We Collect
Collected by SawDash itself: None of your personal information is collected or transmitted by SawDash. The app stores your gameplay progress locally on your device only — highest stage reached, completed levels, coins, best scores/combos, unlocked characters/guns/backgrounds/animations, equipped items, settings (music/sound/vibration), and mission/achievement/daily-reward status. This data is saved to your device's local storage, never to a remote server, and the app has no mandatory account or sign-in system.

3. Advertising & Analytics
SawDash may use Google AdMob to display banner and rewarded video ads. The Google Mobile Ads SDK included in the app may collect information such as your device's advertising identifier, general device and operating-system information, IP address, coarse (non-precise) location derived from IP, and ad interaction/performance data.

4. Rewarded Advertisements
After losing lives in a level, you may voluntarily choose to watch a rewarded advertisement in exchange for an in-game reward — restoring lives and resuming that level. This is entirely optional and is never triggered automatically.

5. Data Security & User Choices
Your game progress is stored only on your own device. You can reset all locally-stored progress at any time from Settings -> Reset Progress, or clear the app's data through your device's app settings.

6. Contact
Questions about this policy or SawDash's data practices can be sent to: viictoriaahiils@gmail.com.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy for Bug Pop Shooter
privacyPolicy.content:
Effective Date: September 8, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how 1D Brain Games ("we", "us", or "our") handles information in connection with the mobile game Bug Pop Shooter ("the Game"), including the Android version and web version.

We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the information associated with the Game.

By using Bug Pop Shooter, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

1. About Bug Pop Shooter

Bug Pop Shooter is a casual puzzle game in which players aim, match, and pop colorful cartoon bugs and insects.

The Game may be available on:

Android phones
Android tablets
Web browsers
Google Chrome
Other supported platforms

The Game may contain advertising, including:

Banner advertisements
Interstitial advertisements
Rewarded advertisements

Some advertisements and related technologies are provided by third-party advertising providers such as Google AdMob.

2. Information We Collect

We aim to keep Bug Pop Shooter simple and do not require users to create an account to play the Game.

We do not intentionally ask players to provide:

Full name
Home address
Phone number
Password
Email address for gameplay
Government identification
Payment card information
Precise GPS location

The Game may, however, process certain information automatically through the Game itself, the device/platform, and third-party services such as advertising or analytics SDKs.

The exact information processed can depend on the platform, SDK configuration, advertising settings, user consent, and applicable law.

3. Information Stored Locally

Bug Pop Shooter may store certain game information locally on the user's device.

This may include:

Current level
Highest unlocked level
Game progress
Coins
Power-ups
Achievements
Daily reward progress
Game settings
Sound settings
Music settings
Vibration settings
Other gameplay preferences

This information is used to provide game functionality and save the player's progress.

Local game data generally remains on the device unless the Game or a third-party service specifically transmits information for another purpose.

4. Advertising

Bug Pop Shooter is supported by advertising.

We may use Google AdMob or other approved advertising technologies to display advertisements.

Advertisements may include:

Banner ads
Interstitial ads
Rewarded ads

For example, a player may voluntarily watch a rewarded advertisement to receive an in-game reward such as coins, an additional attempt, additional shots, or another available reward.

Advertising providers may automatically process certain information from a device or advertising request for purposes such as:

Delivering advertisements
Measuring advertising performance
Preventing fraud
Limiting advertisement frequency
Maintaining advertising services
Providing contextual or, where legally permitted and appropriately configured, personalized advertising

Google explains that its advertising services may involve technologies such as identifiers, IP addresses, cookies or similar technologies.

We configure advertising services in accordance with applicable Google Play, AdMob, privacy, and child-safety requirements.

5. Children's Privacy

Bug Pop Shooter is designed to be a family-friendly game and may be used by children.

We do not intentionally collect personal information directly from children for account creation, and the Game does not require children to provide personal information to play.

Because children may use the Game, we take additional steps intended to comply with applicable children's privacy requirements and Google Play's Families Policy.

Google Play requires apps that include children in their target audience to follow additional requirements regarding data practices, advertising, and third-party SDKs.

Where applicable, advertising requests and advertising behavior are configured according to the user's applicable age treatment and legal requirements.

We do not knowingly use children's personal information for behavioral advertising or interest-based advertising where prohibited by applicable law or platform policies.

Google's policies prohibit personalized advertising based on activity from users known to be under 13 or activity on child-directed apps.

6. Mixed-Audience Users

Bug Pop Shooter is intended to be enjoyable by a broad audience, including children and adults.

Where required, we may use an appropriate age-treatment or neutral age-screening mechanism before certain advertising or data-processing functionality.

This helps us determine the appropriate privacy and advertising treatment where required by applicable law or platform policy.

We do not use an age screen to intentionally collect unnecessary personal information from children.

7. Google AdMob

We may use Google AdMob to display advertisements.

Google and its advertising partners may process information associated with advertising requests, subject to Google's applicable policies and the settings we configure.

Depending on the applicable user, platform, consent status, and advertising configuration, this may include information such as:

IP address
Advertising or app-related identifiers
Device information
Approximate location information
Advertising interaction information
Information related to ad delivery and measurement

Google states that advertising identifiers and other pseudonymous information can be used in advertising systems, while its policies also restrict the use of personally identifiable information and impose additional requirements for children.

We do not intentionally send users' names, email addresses, phone numbers, passwords, or other directly identifying information to Google through Bug Pop Shooter's advertising requests.

For more information about Google's handling of information, please review Google's applicable privacy information:

Google Privacy Policy

8. Advertising Consent

Depending on the user's location and applicable privacy laws, we may request consent before certain types of advertising or data processing.

For users in regions such as the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, applicable consent mechanisms may be used for advertising and privacy choices.

Google provides consent-management functionality for publishers using AdMob.

Where consent is required, users may be provided with choices regarding personalized advertising and applicable data processing.

9. Non-Personalized Advertising

Where required or selected, advertisements may be served as non-personalized advertisements.

Non-personalized advertising generally uses contextual information rather than a user's previous activity for personalization.

Google's advertising documentation explains that non-personalized advertising and restricted-data-processing configurations can limit certain forms of personalized advertising and audience targeting.

10. Rewarded Advertisements

Bug Pop Shooter may provide optional rewarded advertisements.

For example:

Watch an advertisement → Receive coins

or:

Watch an advertisement → Continue the level

Rewarded advertisements are optional.

The Game does not require a player to watch a rewarded advertisement in order to play the basic game.

The advertising provider may process information necessary to deliver and verify the rewarded advertisement.

11. Analytics

Only keep this section if the final Game actually uses an analytics SDK.

We may use analytics services to understand how the Game is used and to improve gameplay, stability, and performance.

Analytics information may include:

Game session information
Level starts
Level completions
Level failures
General gameplay events
Crash or performance information
Device/platform information
Approximate geographic information where provided by the analytics service

We do not intentionally collect names, phone numbers, or email addresses through gameplay analytics.

IMPORTANT FOR THE DEVELOPER: If Bug Pop Shooter does not use Firebase Analytics, Google Analytics, Unity Analytics, GameAnalytics, or another analytics SDK, remove this section before publishing.

12. Crash Reporting

Only keep this section if a crash-reporting SDK is actually installed.

We may use a crash-reporting service to identify crashes and technical problems.

Such a service may automatically process technical information such as:

Device model
Operating system version
Application version
Crash information
Performance information
Diagnostic information

This information is used to identify and fix technical problems.

IMPORTANT FOR THE DEVELOPER: Remove this section if no crash-reporting service is included in the final production build.

13. Third-Party Services

Bug Pop Shooter may use third-party services to provide advertising, platform functionality, analytics, crash reporting, or other technical services.

Depending on the final version of the Game, these may include:

Google Play Services
Google AdMob
Google Play Console-related services
Consent-management services
Analytics services
Crash-reporting services

Third-party providers process information according to their own privacy policies and applicable agreements.

We recommend reviewing their policies for additional information.

14. Google Play Services

The Android version of Bug Pop Shooter may use Google Play Services and other Android platform services.

These services may process technical information required for:

Application distribution
Security
Advertising
Device functionality
Updates
Crash prevention
Other platform functionality

Google's privacy policy explains how Google handles information across its services:

Google Privacy Policy

15. Web Version

Bug Pop Shooter may also be available through web browsers.

The web version may use browser storage technologies such as local storage to save game progress and settings.

The web version may also use advertising technologies if advertising is enabled on the website.

Depending on the advertising and website configuration, third-party services may use cookies, similar technologies, IP addresses, or other identifiers.

Users can manage certain cookie and browser permissions through their browser settings.

16. Cookies and Similar Technologies

The web version may use cookies, local storage, or similar technologies.

These technologies may be used for:

Saving game settings
Saving game progress
Website functionality
Advertising
Measuring advertising performance
Security
Understanding technical problems

Third-party advertising providers may also use cookies or similar technologies where permitted.

Google requires publishers using its products to provide appropriate disclosures regarding technologies such as cookies, web beacons, IP addresses, and identifiers.

17. What We Do Not Do

We do not intentionally:

Sell users' names or contact information
Require users to create an account to play
Ask children for their home address
Ask children for their phone number
Ask children for passwords
Request precise GPS location for gameplay
Collect microphone recordings for gameplay
Collect camera recordings for gameplay
Collect contacts/address books for gameplay
Collect SMS or call logs for gameplay

We also do not intentionally use the Game to identify individual players by their real-world identity.

18. Location Information

Bug Pop Shooter does not require precise GPS location to provide its core gameplay.

We do not intentionally request precise location from users for gameplay.

Advertising or third-party services may independently process approximate location information derived from network or device information where permitted and necessary for their services.

If precise location functionality is ever added, this Privacy Policy will be updated before or when that functionality is introduced.

19. Data Sharing

We do not sell personal information to third parties.

However, information may be transmitted to or processed by third-party service providers when necessary to provide their services.

For example:

Advertising providers may process advertising-related information.
Analytics providers may process analytics information if analytics are enabled.
Crash-reporting providers may process diagnostic information if crash reporting is enabled.
Platform providers may process information necessary to operate their services.

The information shared depends on the services actually integrated into the final version of Bug Pop Shooter.

20. Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect information processed through the Game.

We use appropriate technical and organizational measures where reasonably practicable.

However, no electronic transmission, storage system, or internet service can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

We cannot guarantee absolute security of information transmitted through third-party services.

21. Data Retention

Game progress stored locally remains on the user's device until it is deleted, overwritten, or removed through normal device/application behavior.

Third-party service providers may retain information according to their own policies and retention practices.

Where we control information directly, we retain it only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy or as required by law.

22. Your Privacy Choices

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights concerning your personal information.

These may include rights to:

Request access to information
Request correction
Request deletion
Object to certain processing
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
Request information about data processing

Some rights may be subject to legal limitations.

You may also control certain advertising preferences through:

Device settings
Browser settings
Available consent-management tools
Advertising provider settings
23. Children's Privacy Rights

If you are a parent or legal guardian and believe that a child has provided us with personal information directly, please contact us.

We will review the request and take appropriate action where required by applicable law.

Because Bug Pop Shooter does not require children to create accounts or submit personal information to play, we aim to minimize the collection of information from children.

24. Parents and Guardians

Parents and guardians who have questions about Bug Pop Shooter's privacy practices may contact us using the contact information below.

If you believe that your child has provided personal information to us in a way that you did not authorize, please contact us.

We will take reasonable steps to investigate the matter and address it as required by applicable law.

25. International Users

Bug Pop Shooter may be used by people in different countries.

Depending on where you use the Game, different privacy laws may apply.

These may include, where applicable:

GDPR
UK GDPR
Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA)
Applicable U.S. state privacy laws
India's Digital Personal Data Protection framework
Other applicable privacy and consumer-protection laws

We aim to operate the Game in accordance with applicable laws and platform requirements.

26. European Economic Area, United Kingdom and Switzerland

If you are located in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or Switzerland, applicable privacy laws may provide additional rights.

Where legally required, we may request consent before processing information for certain advertising purposes.

You may have rights including:

Access
Correction
Deletion
Restriction
Objection
Data portability
Withdrawal of consent

You may exercise applicable rights by contacting us.

You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority.

27. United States Privacy Rights

Depending on where you live in the United States, state privacy laws may provide additional rights.

These may include rights to:

Know what personal information is collected
Request deletion
Request correction
Opt out of certain forms of targeted advertising
Opt out of certain sales or sharing of personal information where applicable

The exact rights available depend on applicable state law.

We will respond to valid requests as required by applicable law.

28. India

If you are located in India, applicable Indian data-protection and privacy laws may provide rights concerning personal data.

We will process information in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

If applicable law provides you with additional rights, you may contact us using the information below.

29. Third-Party Privacy Policies

The following third-party services may have their own privacy policies:

Google

Google Privacy Policy

Google AdMob

Google AdMob Privacy and Policies

Google Play

Google Play Privacy Information

If additional third-party services are added to Bug Pop Shooter, this Privacy Policy may be updated to identify them.

30. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.

When we make changes, we will update the:

Last Updated

date at the top of this policy.

If significant changes are made, we may provide additional notice where required by applicable law.

We encourage users and parents/guardians to periodically review this Privacy Policy.

31. Contact Us

If you have questions, concerns, requests, or complaints regarding this Privacy Policy or Bug Pop Shooter's privacy practices, please contact us.
